changeSet.author: bassner
changeSet.comment: Give existing completed transcriptions an initial revision so new Iris runs can verify their timestamps. Leave the hash unknown; the next completed transcription establishes it and advances the revision.

update.where: transcription_version IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lecture_transcription t WHERE t.lecture_unit_id = lecture_unit_processing_state.lecture_unit_id AND t.transcription_status = 'COMPLETED')
